items.title: 5 Dividend Aristocrats That Belong in Every Income Portfolio
items.summary: Not every Dividend Aristocrat deserves space in your portfolio right now, and with tariffs, rate pressure, and AI capex reshaping entire industries, picking the wrong ones could cost you real income. These five names survived a brutal four-factor ranking, but only one scored clean across the board.

items.title: Aflac (AFL) Stock Looks Cheap On Fair Value But Rich On Earnings
items.summary: Aflac stock has delivered strong long term gains over the past five years, yet the current valuation signals are split between what the market is paying and what an intrinsic value estimate suggests the shares may be worth. The Excess Returns model points to a discount to intrinsic value, while earnings based multiples indicate the stock is priced more richly.
